question: As per the rule change in IPL 2022 duration of strategic time out changed from 2:30 minutes to ________ minutes.
solution:
The correct answer is** __3.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **IPL 2022**

 
 
• ​The** fifteenth season **of the Indian Premier League (IPL), a **professional Twenty20 cricket league established in 2007** by the Board of Control for Cricket in India** (BCCI)**, was referred to as IPL 15, or Tata IPL 2022 for sponsorship reasons.
 
• The tournament ran from the **26th of March to the 29th of May in 2022.**
 
• **Mumbai and Pune **served as the tournament's host cities for the entirety of the state of **Maharashtra's group** stage. On March 6, 2022, the tournament's complete schedule was made public.
 
• The league grew during the season, with two new teams joining the fold. Therefore, following the tournament in **2011**, this was the** second season** with **ten teams**. Having won their fourth title the season before, **Chennai Super Kings** were the defending champions.
 
• **Gujarat Titans** won their** first IPL** title by defeating** Rajasthan Royals** by seven wickets in the final.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **TATA IPL Auction - 2022**

 
 
• **​**During the two-day TATA Indian Premier League (IPL) 2022 Auction in **Bengaluru, 204 players** were sold and** INR 5,51,70,00,000** was spent by the **ten teams.**
 
• The auction was dominated by young Indian cricketers, with** Ishan Kishan** receiving the **highest bid of INR 15.25 million**, which allowed him to return to MI.
 
• In the meantime,** Deepak Chahar **became the most expensive Indian** pace bowler** ever purchased at the IPL Auction after returning to** CSK for INR 14 crore.**
 
• **Shreyas Iyer** was bought by KKR for** INR 12.25 billion**, breaking the bank in the process.
 
• At the Auction,** Liam Livingstone, Wanindu Hasaranga, Nicholas Pooran, Shardul Thakur, **and **Lockie Ferguson** also had a good time. Meanwhile, **Avesh Khan** became the most expensive uncapped player in the **IPL's history** when the **new IPL team LSG paid him INR 10 crore.**
